scientific_integrity: Analytical argument for all integer n>=3 and r>=1 with exact finite arithmetic verification as a supplement. The underlying averaging and orthogonal-projection framework is prior work.
scientific_limitations: Relative real coordinate edge-l1 projections only; unweighted, equal-length subdivisions of complete graphs; no assertion for unequal lengths, other graphs, all norm-minimizers, or historical uniqueness.
title: Sharp two-sided \(\ell_1\) projection constants for uniform subdivisions of complete graphs
